001package com.streamconverter;
002
003import java.io.IOException;
004
005/**
006 * Indicates user input error (notification class U in the exception policy): failures where the
007 * remedy is for the end user to correct their input.
008 *
009 * <p>This exception carries a user-friendly message set by the caller. The message must be
010 * sanitized (no internal implementation details, file paths, stack traces, or exception class
011 * names). Sanitization is the responsibility of the code that constructs this exception.
012 *
013 * <p>Examples:
014 *
015 * <ul>
016 *   <li>Malformed CSV row that fails parsing
017 *   <li>JSON data that doesn't match the expected schema
018 *   <li>XML that fails validation
019 *   <li>User input that violates a documented constraint
020 * </ul>
021 *
022 * <p>Extends {@link StreamProcessingException}, and therefore {@link IOException}, so that callers
023 * of {@link com.streamconverter.command.IStreamCommand#execute} can handle all stream-level
024 * failures with a single {@code catch (IOException)} block.
025 *
026 * <p>See docs/reference/EXCEPTION_POLICY.md for the full exception classification policy.
027 *
028 * @see StreamProcessingException
029 * @see ExternalTransientException
030 * @see ExternalPermanentException
031 * @see InternalSystemException
032 */
033public final class UserInputException extends StreamProcessingException {
034  private static final long serialVersionUID = 1L;
035
036  /**
037   * Default user message for when input classification is unknown. Callers should provide a more
038   * specific message at construction time.
039   */
040  public static final String DEFAULT_USER_MESSAGE = "入力データが正しくありません。ご確認の上、再度お試しください。";
041
042  private final String userMessage;
043
044  /**
045   * Constructs a new UserInputException with the specified user-friendly message.
046   *
047   * <p>The message must be sanitized — it should not contain internal implementation details, file
048   * paths, stack traces, or exception class names.
049   *
050   * @param userMessage a sanitized, user-friendly message describing what is wrong with the input
051   *     and how to fix it
052   */
053  public UserInputException(String userMessage) {
054    super(userMessage);
055    this.userMessage = userMessage;
056  }
057
058  /**
059   * Constructs a new UserInputException with the specified user-friendly message and cause.
060   *
061   * <p>The message must be sanitized — it should not contain internal implementation details, file
062   * paths, stack traces, or exception class names.
063   *
064   * @param userMessage a sanitized, user-friendly message describing what is wrong with the input
065   * @param cause the cause of the exception
066   */
067  public UserInputException(String userMessage, Throwable cause) {
068    super(userMessage, cause);
069    this.userMessage = userMessage;
070  }
071
072  /**
073   * Returns the user-friendly message set at construction time.
074   *
075   * <p>This is a dynamic message specific to the input failure. Callers use this to display error
076   * information to end users.
077   *
078   * @return the sanitized user message
079   */
080  @Override
081  public String getUserMessage() {
082    return userMessage;
083  }
084}
